concepts.title: 한 줄 입력 + split + map
concepts.summary: 공백으로 구분된 숫자는 split 후 map(int)로 변환합니다.
concepts.algorithm:
```text
1) 한 줄을 split으로 나눈다.
2) 각 토큰을 int로 변환한다.
```

concepts.title: 서식문자 출력
concepts.summary: %d 개수와 값의 개수가 정확히 맞아야 합니다.
concepts.algorithm:
```text
1) 포맷 문자열을 작성한다.
2) 대응되는 값을 튜플로 넣는다.
```

concepts.title: 문자열 + 정수 혼합 입력
concepts.algorithm:
```text
1) split으로 문자열 두 개를 받는다.
2) score만 int로 변환한다.
```

problems.title: Trace 1. Sum of three integers
problems.description:
Read three integers from one line and compute their sum.
Fill a, b, c, and output.

Example table:
| a | b | c | output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | 5 | 1 | 0 |
problems.code:
a, b, c = map(int, input().split())
print(a + b + c)

problems.title: Trace 2. Reverse output order
problems.description:
Read three values and print them in reverse order.
Write the exact output.
problems.code:
a, b, c = input().split()
print(c, b, a)

problems.title: Reverse 1. Find the third input
problems.description:
You are given a, b and the final output of a + b + c.
Find c. (number only)
problems.code:
a, b, c = map(int, input().split())
print(a + b + c)

problems.title: Trace 3. Count positives
problems.description:
Read four integers one per line.
Count how many are positive. Fill i, num, count for each step.

Example table:
| i | num | count |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ... | ... | 0 |

problems.title: Trace 4. Integer average
problems.description:
Read three integers and compute the integer average using //.
Fill sum and output.

Example table:
| sum | output |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | 0 |
problems.code:
a, b, c = map(int, input().split())
print((a + b + c) // 3)
